```{r}
library(tidyverse)
```


```{r}
data <- read_csv(here::here("plot data","20250914_20250914_PUB_BID_DAM_v3.csv"))
subset <- data |>
  select(STARTTIME, STOPTIME, RESOURCE_TYPE, SCHEDULINGCOORDINATOR_SEQ, RESOURCEBID_SEQ,
         MARKETPRODUCTTYPE, SELFSCHEDMW, SCH_BID_XAXISDATA, SCH_BID_Y1AXISDATA) |>
  mutate(STARTDATETIME = as.factor(STARTTIME),
         STARTTIME = hms::as_hms(STARTTIME))
  # mutate(STARTDATE = date(STARTTIME),
  #        STOPDATE = date(STOPTIME),
  #        STARTTIME = hms::as_hms(STARTTIME),
  #        STOPTIME = hms::as_hms(STOPTIME))
```

```{r}
subset |>
  filter(RESOURCEBID_SEQ == 394840,
         STARTTIME %in% c(hms::as_hms("00:00:00"),
                          hms::as_hms("08:00:00"),
                          hms::as_hms("10:00:00"),
                          hms::as_hms("11:00:00"),
                          hms::as_hms("12:00:00"))) |>
  ggplot(aes(x=SCH_BID_XAXISDATA, y=SCH_BID_Y1AXISDATA, 
             color = STARTDATETIME, group=STARTDATETIME)) +
  geom_line() +
  geom_point()
```


```{r}
plot_curves <- function(market_data, resource_id){
    date <- as.Date(market_data$STARTTIME[1])

    plot <- market_data |>
        mutate(STARTDATETIME = as.factor(STARTTIME),
               STARTTIME = hms::as_hms(STARTTIME)) |>
        filter(RESOURCEBID_SEQ == resource_id) |>
       #  STARTTIME %in% c(hms::as_hms("00:00:00"),
       #                    hms::as_hms("04:00:00"),
       #                    hms::as_hms("08:00:00"),
       #                    hms::as_hms("13:00:00"),
       #                    hms::as_hms("20:00:00"))) |>
        ggplot(aes(x=SCH_BID_XAXISDATA, y=SCH_BID_Y1AXISDATA, 
             color = STARTDATETIME, group=STARTDATETIME)) +
        geom_line() +
        geom_point() +
       #  xlim(-Inf, Inf) +
        labs(
            x="Quantity (MW)",
            y = "Bid Price ($/MWh)",
            title = sprintf("ID: %s Date: %s", resource_id, date)) +
        theme_minimal()
       plot
}

plot_curves(data, 394840)
```

sept14 <- read_csv(here::here("plot data", "20250914_20250914_PUB_BID_DAM_v3.csv"))
sept14plot <- plot_curves(sept14, 394840)
ggsave(here::here("plots", "sept14filter.png"))

```{r}
# area between curves plot
s14hr0 <- sept14 |>
       mutate(STARTDATETIME = as.factor(STARTTIME),
              STARTDATTE = as.Date(STARTDATETIME),
               STARTTIME = hms::as_hms(STARTTIME)) |>
       filter(RESOURCEBID_SEQ == 394840,
       STARTTIME == hms::as_hms("00:00:00"))

o01hr0 <- oct01 |>
       mutate(STARTDATETIME = as.factor(STARTTIME),
              STARTDATTE = as.Date(STARTDATETIME),
               STARTTIME = hms::as_hms(STARTTIME)) |>
       filter(RESOURCEBID_SEQ == 394840,
       STARTTIME == hms::as_hms("00:00:00"))

s14hr0 |>
       bind_rows(o01hr0) |>
       ggplot(aes(x=SCH_BID_XAXISDATA, y=SCH_BID_Y1AXISDATA,
       color = as.factor(STARTDATTE), group = STARTDATTE)) +
       geom_point() +
       geom_line() + 
       labs(color = 'Date',
       title = "RESOURCE ID: 394840") +
       theme_minimal() 
ggsave(here::here("plots","area-bw-curves.png"))
```
